traits.label: Foodie
traits.description: Lives to eat. Gets hungry faster and loves the kitchen.

traits.label: Bookworm
traits.description: Happiest with a good book; reading is twice as tempting.

traits.label: Couch Potato
traits.description: Drawn to the TV and the sofa. Not in a hurry.

traits.label: Neat
traits.description: Feels grubby quickly and keeps up with chores.

traits.label: Slob
traits.description: Barely notices the dirt. Showers are optional.

traits.label: Energetic
traits.description: Always on the move and slow to tire.

traits.label: Lazy
traits.description: Tires quickly and never says no to a nap.

traits.label: Cheerful
traits.description: Sees the bright side. Mood gets a steady boost.

traits.label: Gloomy
traits.description: A little melancholy; bored more easily.

traits.label: Nature Lover
traits.description: Feels at home around plants and loves tending them.

traits.label: Outgoing
traits.description: Loves company and gets lonely fast.

traits.label: Loner
traits.description: Happy with their own company; small talk is a chore.

traits.label: Romantic
traits.description: Dreams of love; flirts often and is easy to woo.

traits.label: Hot-headed
traits.description: Quick to anger and slow to forgive.

traits.label: Kind
traits.description: Warm and forgiving; never starts trouble.

perks.label: Easily Amused
perks.description: Gets 30% more fun out of everything.

perks.label: Charming
perks.description: Friendly and romantic advances land more often.
